sources: Search for a City of White River web page (2026-11-22): no town website found; the only official listings near it are Mellette County offices (dakotaathome.sd.gov) which say nothing about the campground

Google Maps search 'White River City Park White River SD campground' (headless, 2026-11-22): two results - 'White River City Campground', Campground, 4.5 (6), (605) 259-3242, at 43.56445,-100.74137; and 'White River City Park & Campground', City park, 4.0 (29), 519 Parkway St, 'Open 24 hours'

https://thedyrt.com/camping/south-dakota/south-dakota-white-river-city-park (aggregator, read 2026-11-22): listed 'Free', 12 sites ('Roughly 10 of the 12 sites sit under tree cover'); reviews Jul. 18, 2026 'Bathrooms on the south side are clean.'; Jun. 13, 2026 'WAZE is slightly wrong. Campground is on right - look for the showground sign.'; Jun. 13, 2026 'Pit toilets were open but not cared for.'; Jul. 4, 2025; May 14, 2025 'There is an outhouse but it was locked.'

Web search summary of aggregator listings (The Dyrt, ParkAdvisor 10 sites, AllStays), 2026-11-22: free, back-in sites, water spigot, an Aug 2025 review that low-hanging branches blocked some of the better sites for trailers, potholes on the gravel road

Esri World_Imagery 43.5648,-100.7418 (hw 250 m), 2026-11-22: the pin sits on a treed block south of the east-west street with a gravel loop road through it; the city park/ballfield is the block to the west and the rodeo/livestock grounds lie east and south; no water within the frame
note: City of White River campground at the south edge of town beside the rodeo showground (look for the showground sign; some map apps place it slightly off): about 10-12 back-in spaces on a gravel loop under trees, where low branches block some sites for taller rigs. Pit toilets whose upkeep varies; no posted hookups. The town has no web page for it: call (605) 259-3242, the number on its Google listing, to confirm it is open. --Claude

Pin on the campground block; not waterfront.
